intro.text: A Herdazian member of Bridge Four.
A Herdazian Windrunner of Bridge Four who sails with his cousin Lopen on the Thaylen expedition to Akinah.

items.text: Lopen brought Huio and another cousin, Rod, into Bridge Four. Huio was often on kitchen duty with Rock, asking for it more as the others became squires. Once he threw a handful of lazbo into a pot of Rock's shiki, horrifying Rock until he tasted it and found the recipe improved; after that Rock sought his advice on cooking.

Huio took shifts guarding the Kholins and went with Dalinar to Thaylen City, where Bridge Four heard the translation of the Eila Stele. Disheartened, they returned to Urithiru without him and found their barracks attacked: Rock and Bisig badly hurt and Eth dead. As the best field medic there, Huio tended Rock until he could be brought to Renarin.
Once he began earning a Radiant's stipend, Huio sent most of it home to help his poorer cousins, much of it to Rod's family.

Chosen with Lopen to join the expedition to Akinah aboard the Wandersail because both could swim, Huio helped the crew with shipboard work. Lopen often translated jokes for him, as his Alethi was poor. Tinkering with the ardent Rushu's spanreed and some aluminum foil, he stumbled on a way that aluminum could alter fabrials.
When the porter Nikli's plot to sabotage the expedition was uncovered, Huio and Lopen flew him ashore to be held.

On Akinah, Huio fought a huge creature attacking the Wandersail until Lopen arrived to save him from its jaws. When Lopen fell injured, Huio swore the Third Ideal to protect him, summoned his spren Caelinora as a Shardhammer to shatter the creature's arm, then killed it with a Shardspear.

After Kaladin stepped back from fighting, Huio and most of the Bridge Four Windrunners joined Dalinar's forces in Emul, where Huio played cards with Lopen between battles. He gathered with the rest of Bridge Four for Teft's funeral.
Huio went into business with Rysn, and together they registered a Thaylen patent for fabrials modified with aluminum.
Many years later, Huio was known among arcanists at the Silverlight university, and Eddlin named him, along with Argent and Jess, as someone who could verify an ancient Iriali map.

appearance.text: A short, bald, beefy man with thick arms.

personality.text: Quieter than his cousin Lopen, Huio is embarrassed by his poor Alethi but proud of his cooking, and likes his sandwiches with the bread in the middle. He is curious and scientifically minded, fond of taking fabrials apart to see how they work, often breaking them for good. Bridge Four know him for visiting prostitutes.
